questions.question: In Economics, what term describes a simultaneous occurrence of stagnant economic growth and high inflation?
questions.hint: Stagflation is economic stagnation combined with inflation.

questions.question: Which organ of the Indian Union Judiciary is empowered to issue Writs under Article 32?
questions.hint: Article 32 gives Supreme Court constitutional remedies and writ powers.

questions.question: Under the Constitution of India, which Article guarantees the Right to Equality before Law?
questions.hint: Article 14 ensures equality before law and equal protection of laws.

questions.question: Which Indian National Highway connects Kashmir in the north to Kanyakumari in the south?
questions.hint: NH 44 is the longest national highway in India.
